hypothesis: HS300 stocks with wider high-low bid-ask spread estimates may earn an illiquidity premium; combining high Corwin-Schultz spread with defensive quality and cash quality can improve returns without worsening drawdown.

factor.formula: 60-day rolling mean of the Corwin-Schultz two-day high-low spread estimate, using the estimate from t-1/t assigned to t to avoid lookahead; negative estimates clipped to zero
factor.returns: adjusted high and low from kline_daily_enriched
factor.direction: higher is better (wider estimated effective spread / higher illiquidity premium)
factor.point_in_time: the spread estimate available on date t uses only high/low through close t; execution remains T+1 open

control_strategy.purpose: Matched universe and execution; Corwin-Schultz spread is an availability filter only, not a score component.

execution.universe: historical HS300 membership; monthly snapshots for 2018-2020 and daily snapshots from 2021

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2018-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2018-2026 curve

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical HS300 membership over 2018-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: factor has at least 60 available spread observations before its first valid value and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.G1: independent 2018-2020 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: independent 2018-2020 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2021-2024 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. Thresholds may not be relaxed after results. Any failed gate means the candidate remains research-only and is not a deployable factor.
known_limitations: The Corwin-Schultz estimator is inferred from daily high/low ranges rather than quoted bid-ask spreads.
The estimate is lagged one day to avoid using next-day high/low at signal time.
Adjusted high/low history is used; corporate actions are handled by the enriched pipeline.
2018-2020 HS300 membership uses monthly snapshots, so intra-month index changes are not modeled.
